title: Alvor Healthcare Adds Cardiovascular Product to Distribution Portfolio
excerpt: Portfolio expansion gives healthcare and supply partners another cardiovascular product option.
content:
Alvor Healthcare has added a cardiovascular medicine to its distribution portfolio. The addition expands the range of product options available for discussion with qualified healthcare and supply partners.

Availability, approved indications, prescribing information, and registration status vary by market. Partners should contact Alvor Healthcare with the product and destination country to request current product information and applicable documentation.

The commercial and supply teams will coordinate availability planning, storage requirements, order enquiries, and shipment information. Healthcare professionals should rely on the locally approved product information when making prescribing decisions.
author: Corporate Communications

title: Alvor Healthcare Strengthens Distribution Quality Controls
excerpt: Updated processes reinforce supplier review, documentation, storage oversight, and product traceability.
content:
Alvor Healthcare has strengthened the quality controls used across its pharmaceutical distribution activities. The updated approach focuses on supplier qualification, product-document review, storage requirements, batch traceability, stock rotation, complaint handling, and recall coordination.

The work clarifies responsibilities at each stage from product onboarding through delivery and post-distribution communication. It also gives internal teams a consistent process for recording decisions, escalating concerns, and responding to documentation requests.

As a distributor, Alvor Healthcare works with pharmaceutical suppliers, logistics providers, healthcare organizations, and distribution partners to maintain clear records and responsible product handling. Product-specific certificates and market documents remain subject to availability and verification.
author: Quality Assurance Team

title: Alvor Healthcare Expands Operations into Southeast Asia
excerpt: New distribution partnerships established in 6 countries to improve medication access.
content:
Alvor Healthcare has announced a major strategic expansion into Southeast Asian markets, establishing distribution partnerships in six countries including Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Singapore. This expansion marks a significant milestone in the company's global growth strategy.

The new distribution network will initially focus on Alvor's core therapeutic categories including cardiovascular, anti-infective, and gastroenterology products. Local regulatory filings have been completed or are in advanced stages, with product launches expected to begin in Q2 2025.

Each partnership has been carefully selected based on the distributor's infrastructure, regulatory expertise, and market reach. Alvor will provide comprehensive training and support to ensure proper handling, storage, and distribution of pharmaceutical products in compliance with local regulations.

This expansion is expected to improve access to quality, affordable medications for millions of patients across the region while strengthening Alvor's presence in one of the world's fastest-growing pharmaceutical markets.
author: Business Development
